title: Scheduled FOMC decision-day full-UTC-day BTC risk veto
thesis: The complete UTC day containing the final date of a regularly scheduled FOMC meeting may have worse BTC return and path risk than same-window non-event days because a calendar-known policy statement changes discount-rate expectations and concentrates uncertainty.
mechanism: A scheduled policy decision can cause cross-asset repricing and liquidity withdrawal around the statement, increasing BTC downside incidence or intraday drawdown even though an adversarial macro-disconnect prior makes the direction and persistence uncertain.
economic_rationale: A spot-only policy that exits BTC at 00:00 UTC on each frozen regular-meeting final date and reenters at the next 00:00 UTC is useful only if avoided event-day losses and drawdown exceed two fee-and-adverse-slippage transitions per event and foregone positive event-day upside under matched capital.
